name: profile
author: Kiran Shrestha
description: Personal portfolio and GitHub profile built with RxHtml framework

scripts.start: npm run build:css && npx http-server public -p 8080 -o
scripts.dev: npm run watch:css & npx http-server public -p 8080 -o
scripts.build: npm run build:css && powershell -Command "if (-Not (Test-Path build)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path build } ; Copy-Item -Path public/* -Destination build/ -Recurse -Force"
